messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
No. Because the staff member rejected the first proposal, it does not keep the refund window open. A later request for the seat cushion must still be made within 30 days of delivery; the exception for an earlier timely proposal does not apply to rejected proposals (refund-policy/v2/window).

Your order records show the cushion was received back and has not been refunded (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/remaining). Would you like me to check whether a new request is still within the deadline?
